layout.ticket_booking.title: Booking
layout.ticket_booking.description:
In this channel, you can book tickets for the SFL football match and The Weeknd's performance



The advantages of the booking are the beautiful view and proximity to the artist and the field. The server can be accessed from both a licensed and a pirated version of the game. This time, the server will be closed to players who have not booked.

This time our hall consists of 2 floors. The hall is divided into 4 zones: Red Sector, Yellow Sector, White Sector, Purple Sector. You can see the map of places by clicking on the button below. ↓

>>> Players who have not booked seats will not be allowed on the server. You have the opportunity to get a good place with the best view. One ticket is designed for 3 people.
